panel.title: Data sources
panel.intro: Connect municipal and smart-city data sources to give your website components real data.
panel.createIntro: Three short questions. Nothing is read from the API until you add a dataset.
panel.connected: {count, plural, one {# connected source} other {# connected sources}}
panel.emptyDescription: Until you connect one, components show sample data. All you need is the web address of an API that returns JSON.

sourceCard.confirmDelete: Remove this data source and all of its datasets? This cannot be undone.
sourceCard.untestedHint: Not tested yet. Test the connection to make sure the API can be reached; datasets can be added once it answers.
sourceCard.failedHint: Fix the address or the API, then test again. Datasets can be added once the test succeeds.
sourceCard.failedWithDatasets: The existing datasets are kept, but components using them cannot load current data until the source answers again. New datasets can be added once a test succeeds.

sourceForm.name: Source name

pagination.recordsPathHint: Where the list of records sits in the response, as a dot path such as data.items. Leave empty to detect common layouts.

hints.offset: The API takes a page size and a start position as query parameters.
hints.page: The API takes a page number, and optionally a page size.
hints.cursor: Each response names a token that is sent back to get the next page.
hints.next-url: Each response contains the address of the next page. It must stay on the same host.

fields.nextCursorPath: Path of the next cursor in the response
fields.nextUrlPath: Path of the next page link in the response

sourceForm.credentialHint: The credential is not stored here. It must be set on the server as an environment variable; ask your administrator.
sourceForm.baseUrlHint: The address the records are read from. It must start with https:// or http://.
sourceForm.afterSave: You can test the connection right after saving.

identity.title: Name it
identity.description: A name your team recognises in lists and in the editor.

location.title: Where is the data?
location.description: The API address, and whether it needs a key.

advanced.title: Advanced: records and pagination
advanced.description: Only needed if the API wraps its records unusually or returns them in pages. Common layouts are detected automatically.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.empty: This source has no datasets yet. Add one.
datasets.confirmDelete: Delete this dataset and its field mapping? This cannot be undone.
datasets.firstTitle: Next: say what this source provides
datasets.firstDescription: A dataset is one list of records from this source, for example the events or the measuring stations. Components use datasets, not sources.
datasets.titleOf: {count, plural, =0 {Datasets of {source}} one {# dataset of {source}} other {# datasets of {source}}}
datasets.unused: Not used on any page yet.
datasets.liveOnly: No draft uses it any more, but the live site still shows it on: {pages}, until the next publish.

datasetForm.title: Add a dataset
datasetForm.name: Name
datasetForm.pathHint: Appended to the source's base URL. Leave empty to use the source's own path.

mapping.title: Map fields
mapping.noFields: No fields were found in the data source's response.
mapping.tableCaption: Assignment of external fields to target fields
mapping.targetOption: {label}{required, select, yes { *} other {}}{taken, select, yes { (already assigned)} other {}}

errors.dataSourceNotFound: The data source was not found.
errors.datasetSlugTaken: A dataset with this name already exists in this data source.
errors.datasetNotMapped: This dataset has no field mapping yet.
errors.mappingFailed: The mapping could not be applied to a record of the source.
errors.connectionFailed: Connection failed: the data source could not be reached.
errors.connectionTimedOut: Connection failed: the request timed out.
errors.authenticationFailed: Authentication failed: the data source rejected the credentials.
errors.upstreamError: Invalid response: the data source returned an error.
errors.upstreamRedirected: Invalid response: the address redirects elsewhere. Enter the final address of the data (for example with https and the full path).
errors.responseTooLarge: Invalid response: the data source's response was too large.
errors.responseUnreadable: Invalid response: the data source's response could not be read.
errors.responseNotJson: Invalid response: the data source did not return valid JSON.
errors.noSampleRecords: Invalid response: the data source returned no sample records.
errors.recordsNotFound: Invalid response: no record list was found at the configured records path. Check the path or leave it empty.
errors.credentialsMissing: Invalid configuration: the credentials are not set up on the server.
errors.connectorUnavailable: Invalid configuration: no connector is available for this data source type yet.
errors.addressNotAllowed: Invalid configuration: this address is not allowed.
errors.infrastructure: A service error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.datasetInUse: A page still shows this data, so it was not deleted. The page has been reloaded with the current usage.

validation.nameTooShort: The name must be at least {nameMin} characters long.
validation.nameTooLong: The name must be at most {nameMax} characters long.
validation.kindUnknown: This data source type is not available.
validation.urlSchemeNotAllowed: Only http and https addresses are allowed.
validation.urlCredentialsNotAllowed: Addresses containing a username or password are not allowed.
validation.requestBodyInvalid: The request body must be a JSON object, and only POST sources send one.
validation.recordsPathInvalid: The records path is invalid. Use a dot path such as data.items.
validation.paginationInvalid: The pagination settings are incomplete or invalid.
validation.windowInvalid: The requested range of records is invalid.
validation.authModeUnsupported: This authentication type is not available.
validation.datasetNameTooShort: The name must be at least {datasetNameMin} characters long.
validation.datasetNameTooLong: The name must be at most {datasetNameMax} characters long.
validation.slugRequired: No key can be derived from this name.
validation.slugTooLong: The key must be at most {slugMax} characters long.
validation.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens are allowed.
validation.canonicalKindUnknown: Please choose a valid dataset type.
validation.mappingFieldCountInvalid: Assign at least one and at most {maxFields} fields.
validation.targetPathUnknown: This target field does not exist for the chosen type.
validation.targetPathConflict: This target field is already assigned to another field.
validation.valueNotNumber: The value is not a valid number.
validation.valueNotBoolean: The value is not a valid true/false value.
validation.valueNotDate: The value is not a valid date.
validation.valueNotUrl: The value is not a valid http(s) URL.
validation.valueMissing: The value is required but missing.

guide.title: How real data gets onto your pages

source.title: Connect a source
source.description: The address of an API, such as an open data portal.

dataset.title: Add a dataset
dataset.description: One list of records from it, such as events or measuring stations.

mapping.title: Map the fields
mapping.description: Say which field holds the title, the date, the location and so on.

use.title: Use it on a page
use.description: Pick the dataset in a component in the page editor.

guide.ready: Your data is ready. Last step: choose a dataset in a component such as a map, list or chart.
guide.readyFor: Your data is ready. Last step: "{page} › {component}" still shows sample data; choose your dataset there.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: A form or a field mapping on this page has changes that are not saved yet. They are lost if you leave.
leave.mappingDescription: The field mapping you are editing has unsaved assignments. Opening another one discards them.

inUse.title: "{name}" is still in use
inUse.description: {count, plural, one {A component still shows this data.} other {# components still show this data.}} On the live site missing data shows an error, so choose another dataset for {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first. Then it can be deleted.
inUse.liveDescription: No page in the editor uses it any more, but the live site still shows it on: {pages}. Publish your changes first; then it can be deleted.
